MG Coolness
Use naptha/alchohol extraction process as described.  Allowed grainy seed mash to dry for entire day before mixing w/ 100 proof vodka. Spread this mash thinly over a dinner plate to dry.
After all naptha had evaporated, and mash was dry, it had a pleasent nutty scent, not a solvent smell at all.  Believe that naptha weakened effects slightly.  Water extraction with same dosage next.  Very positive, nice experience, absolutely no negative effects.
Don't do drugs anyway.
